response.justification: Strong, long-tenured generalist engineer with staff-level titles, real breadth (backend, web, mobile, embedded, low-latency systems), mentoring/teaching credentials, and recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic developer tooling. However, the core requirement of 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions is not met — AI-related work appears limited to roughly the last year. The resume shows no Python, no vector databases or RAG architectures, no multi-agent frameworks, no LLM evaluation/observability work, and only light cloud exposure (AWS CDK). Engineering fundamentals and the MCP/agent tooling angle make this worth a screening call for a more junior or platform-leaning GenAI role, but as a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI Engineer the domain gap is substantial.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production software; staff-level scope and mentoring track record
Recent hands-on MCP server/code-generator and agentic workflow tooling experience
Strong TypeScript/Node, distributed systems, testing/CI discipline, and consulting/customer-facing background
concerns: AI/GenAI experience is ~1 year, far short of the required 8+ years
No evidence of RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent frameworks
Python absent from skills; limited cloud-scale AI/data-pipeline design experience

key_factors.factor: RAG / vector DB / agent framework gap
Senior engineering breadth and MCP/agent tooling exposure
